name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Management & Customer Success | Account Growth, Renewals & Delivery Oversight
summary: Account executive and customer success leader with 15+ years owning both the commercial and delivery side of client relationships in SaaS, agency, and services environments. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, selling and scoping CRM and project-management platforms and handing sequenced implementation plans to delivery. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (deals ~$10K-$45K) and held 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets at Wix, including work with established retail businesses. Grows accounts by reading delivery performance for the next opportunity, and leads executive-level reviews focused on outcomes. Denver based.
